# 2 Kings Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 232r–233r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_011_page_001.jpg, 2KI_011_page_002.jpg, 2KI_011_page_003.jpg

---

**11:1** And-Atalyahu [Athaliah], mother of-Achazyahu, saw that her-son was-dead, and-she-arose and-destroyed [va-te'abbed] all the-seed of-the-kingdom [zera' ha-mamlakhah].

**11:2** And-took Yehosheva [Jehosheba], daughter of-the-king Yoram, sister of-Achazyahu, Yo'ash [Joash] son of-Achazyahu, and-stole-him from-the-midst of-the-sons of-the-king [who were] being-put-to-death [mumatim], him and-his-nurse [meynaqto], in-the-room of-the-beds [chadar ha-mittot]. And-they-hid him from-the-face of-Atalyahu, and-he-was-not put-to-death.

**11:3** And-he-was with-her hiding [mitchabbe'] in-the-house of-YHWH six years. And-Atalyah [was] reigning [moleshet] over the-land.

**11:4** And-in-the-seventh year, Yehoyada [Jehoiada] sent and-took the-commanders of-the-hundreds [sarey ha-me'ot] of-the-Karim [Carites] and-of-the-runners [ha-ratsim], and-brought them to-him to-the-house of-YHWH, and-cut [vayikhrot] with-them a-covenant [berit], and-made-them-swear [vayashba'] in-the-house of-YHWH, and-showed-them the-son of-the-king.

**11:5** And-he-commanded them, saying: This [is] the-thing that you-shall-do: the-third of-you, [those] coming [on] the-Shabbat, and-keeping the-guard [mishmeret] of-the-house of-the-king,

**11:6** and-the-third [is] at-the-gate of-Sur, and-the-third at-the-gate behind the-runners — and-you-shall-keep the-guard of-the-house [as] a-barrier [massach].

**11:7** And-two parts of-you [ha-yadot], all [those] going-out [on] the-Shabbat — and-they-shall-keep the-guard of-the-house of-YHWH around [el] the-king.

**11:8** And-you-shall-surround [ve-hiqqaftem] the-king all-around, each-man and-his-weapons [kelav] in-his-hand. And-the-one-coming into the-rows [ha-sederot] shall-be-put-to-death. And-be with the-king when-he-goes-out and-when-he-comes-in.

**11:9** And-did the-commanders of-the-hundreds according-to-all that Yehoyada the-priest commanded, and-they-took each his-men, [those] coming [on] the-Shabbat with [those] going-out [on] the-Shabbat, and-came to Yehoyada the-priest.

**11:10** And-gave the-priest to-the-commanders of-the-hundreds the-spears [ha-chaniyot] and-the-shields [ha-shlatim] that [were] King David's, which [were] in-the-house of-YHWH.

**11:11** And-stood the-runners, each-man and-his-weapons in-his-hand, from-the-right shoulder [ketef] of-the-house to-the-left shoulder of-the-house, by the-altar and-by the-house, around the-king.

**11:12** And-he-brought-out the-son of-the-king and-put upon-him the-crown [ha-nezer] and-the-testimony [ha-edut], and-they-made-him-king [vayamlikhu] and-anointed-him [vayimshachuhu]. And-they-clapped [vayakku] the-palm [kaph] and-said: Long-live [yechi] the-king!

**11:13** And-heard Atalyah the-sound of-the-runners [and] the-people, and-she-came to the-people [at] the-house of-YHWH.

**11:14** And-she-looked, and-behold, the-king [was] standing by the-pillar [ha-'amud] according-to-the-custom [ka-mishpat], and-the-commanders and-the-trumpets [ha-chatsotsrot] [were] by the-king, and-all the-people of-the-land [were] rejoicing and-blowing [toke'ey] trumpets. And-tore Atalyah her-garments and-cried: Conspiracy! Conspiracy! [Qesher! Qesher!]

**11:15** And-commanded Yehoyada the-priest the-commanders of-the-hundreds, the-appointed-ones of-the-army [pequdey ha-chayil], and-said to-them: Bring-her-out to-between [mi-beyt] the-rows [la-sederot], and-the-one-coming after-her — put-to-death with-the-sword. For the-priest said: Let-her-not be-put-to-death [in] the-house of-YHWH.

**11:16** And-they-set [vayasimu] for-her hands [yadayim], and-she-came [by] the-way of-the-entrance of-the-horses to-the-house of-the-king, and-she-was-put-to-death there.

**11:17** And-cut [vayikhrot] Yehoyada the-covenant [ha-berit] between YHWH and-between the-king and-between the-people, to-be a-people [le-'am] to-YHWH; and-between the-king and-between the-people.

**11:18** And-came all the-people of-the-land [to] the-house of-Ba'al, and-tore-it-down [vayittetsuhu]. His-altars [mizbehotav] and-his-images [tslamav] they-broke [shibberu] thoroughly [heytev], and-Mattan, priest of-Ba'al, they-killed before the-altars. And-set the-priest [Yehoyada] overseers [pequddot] over the-house of-YHWH.

**11:19** And-he-took the-commanders of-the-hundreds and-the-Karim and-the-runners and-all the-people of-the-land, and-they-brought-down the-king from-the-house of-YHWH and-came [by] the-way of-the-gate of-the-runners [to] the-house of-the-king. And-he-sat upon the-throne of-the-kings [kisse' ha-melakhim].

**11:20** And-rejoiced all the-people of-the-land, and-the-city [was] quiet [shaqetah]. And-Atalyahu they-put-to-death with-the-sword [at] the-house of-the-king.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — the room of the beds:** Hebrew *chadar ha-mittot* — a bedroom or storage room within the royal complex. Jehosheba smuggles the infant Joash and his wet-nurse into hiding from Athaliah's massacre of the royal seed.

**v.4 — the Carites (Karim):** A foreign mercenary unit, often identified with Carians from southwestern Anatolia. They serve as royal bodyguards alongside the "runners" (*ratsim*), the standard palace guard corps. Jehoiada's coup depends on military, not popular, support.

**v.12 — the crown and the testimony:** *Ha-nezer* (the crown/diadem) and *ha-edut* (the testimony/decree). The *edut* likely refers to a written covenant document or royal protocol — the terms of kingship under YHWH. Coronation is not merely political; it is covenantal.

**v.14 — standing by the pillar:** The king's place by the pillar (*ha-'amud*) during ceremonies is a fixed custom (*ka-mishpat*). This pillar, likely at the temple entrance, is the location where the Davidic covenant is publicly renewed.

**v.17 — double covenant:** Jehoiada cuts two covenants: (1) between YHWH and king-and-people (theological), and (2) between king and people (political). The Davidic kingship is reestablished on a dual foundation — divine election and popular consent.

*— EMET*
